The proved finite-support results derive the cell-average regression rate internally, and no theorem depends on this standalone L4 regression-rate assumption.
No discharged result invokes the generic nuisance product-rate: the attainment proof substitutes the stronger derived root-n cell rates directly.

This quadratic covariance/loading rate is unused by every discharged theorem; the fixed-support gap delta proof uses only its own moment-map rank argument.
